Dua for Breaking the Fast | Hisn al-Muslim 176

Dua for Breaking the Fast (Hisn al-Muslim 176). A dua every Muslim should know:
The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

If you notice any mistake or issue in this video, please contact us at tdh@reclaivo.com

Recitation: Muhammad Jumah for OpenDua
Arabic, transliteration and translation: OpenDua (opendua.org), CC BY 4.0
Source: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim) by Sa'id bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani
